evals.name: tap-then-home
evals.prompt: I'm running an iPhone 16 Pro simulator. Please tap the center of the screen and then send the app to background.
expected_behavior: Resolves the simulator's UDID and ensures a stream helper is running (`headless-serve-sim --detach -q <UDID>`) before sending input.
Uses `headless-serve-sim tap 0.5 0.5 -d <UDID>` (NOT two `gesture` calls for begin/end) for the tap.
Uses `headless-serve-sim button home` (or `swipe_home` on Face ID devices) to background the app.
Does NOT pass pixel coordinates.

evals.name: camera-injection-rotate
evals.prompt: Test the camera flow of my app com.acme.MyApp. Inject this image as the camera feed (~/Pictures/test.png), force mirror off so any text in the image reads correctly, then rotate to landscape_left.
expected_behavior: Checks macOS major version is 14+ before attempting camera injection.
Runs `headless-serve-sim camera com.acme.MyApp --file ~/Pictures/test.png --mirror off` (or `--no-mirror`).
Runs `headless-serve-sim rotate landscape_left` (with a running stream helper) and confirms it landed via the helper's `/config` `interfaceOrientation`.
Verifies camera helper state via `headless-serve-sim camera status`.
Tears down with `headless-serve-sim camera --stop-webcam` when finished.

evals.name: stream-and-pull-notification-center
evals.prompt: Stream my simulator so I can share the URL remotely. Then drag down from the top edge to open Notification Center.
expected_behavior: Starts the browser preview for the device (`headless-serve-sim <UDID>` in the background), waits for its `- Local:` line and surfaces that URL; mentions the toolbar QR code or a tunnel for remote viewing, and does not present the `--detach` helper URL as the shareable page.
Issues a gesture sequence (begin → move → end) with `edge: 2` (top), starting at low y (~0.01-0.02) and dragging down to y ~0.4 or further.
Each gesture call uses `headless-serve-sim gesture '<json>'` with valid normalized coordinates (or one WebSocket for the whole sequence).
Does NOT use `tap` for this multi-step gesture.

evals.name: blended-layers-debug
evals.prompt: I think my settings screen has too many blended layers — can you turn on the CoreAnimation blended overlay, take a screenshot, and turn it off again?
expected_behavior: Runs `headless-serve-sim ca-debug blended on` (alias accepted; `debug_color_blended` also valid) with a running stream helper.
Captures the screen with `headless-serve-sim screenshot <path>` (or `xcrun simctl io <UDID> screenshot`), not by grabbing a frame from the MJPEG stream.
Runs `headless-serve-sim ca-debug blended off` after capture.
Reports the path to the saved screenshot and what the red (blended) regions show.

evals.name: ax-driven-tap
evals.prompt: There's a Submit button somewhere on the current screen. Tap it without me telling you where it is.
expected_behavior: Fetches the accessibility tree from the helper's `/ax` endpoint (URL read from the state file or `--list <UDID>`, not an assumed port).
Locates an element whose `AXLabel` matches 'Submit' (case-insensitive), searching nested `children`.
Computes the element centre and normalizes it by the AX root frame (points), not `/config` pixels, then calls `headless-serve-sim tap <nx> <ny>`.
If no matching element is found, reports that — does not guess coordinates.

evals.name: preview-handoff
evals.prompt: I've got my app running in the iPhone 16 Pro simulator. Stream it and show me the preview right here in this agent — don't make me open another window.
expected_behavior: Starts the preview server for the device in the background (`headless-serve-sim <UDID or name>`), waits for the `- Local:` line and extracts that URL (default http://localhost:3200) — does NOT treat `--detach` output as the preview page.
Surfaces the URL plainly in the response so the user has a manual fallback.
Inspects available tools for a preview/URL-opening capability (`preview_start`, `mcp__Claude_Preview__preview_start`, `browser_open`, etc.) and calls it with the URL if found.
If no such tool is available, explicitly tells the user that and instructs them to open the URL in their host's browser/preview pane.
Does NOT try to install, build, or launch the app — assumes the simulator + app are already running per the prompt.
Does NOT invent a host-specific tool name that doesn't exist in the current session.
